title: Border Draw Button
summary: Two lines race around the perimeter and meet to complete the frame.
description: Two pseudo-elements scale on opposite axes with a delay, drawing the outline rather than fading it in.
accessibility_notes: Use a real <button>; keep a visible :focus-visible ring and never rely on hover alone to convey state. Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
variations: Thicker lines for a bolder frame
ai_usage: Minimal and editorial designs. Each pseudo-element covers two sides via border-top/right (and bottom/left) and animates scaleX then scaleY with a transition-delay — the delay is what makes it draw instead of appear.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Border Draw Button</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "border-draw-button",
    "title": "Border Draw Button",
    "summary": "Two lines race around the perimeter and meet to complete the frame.",
    "description": "Two pseudo-elements scale on opposite axes with a delay, drawing the outline rather than fading it in.",
    "theme": "buttons",
    "categories": ["button", "border"],
    "tags": ["border", "draw", "outline", "hover", "minimal"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Use a real <button>; keep a visible :focus-visible ring and never rely on hover alone to convey state. Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--c", "description": "Line color", "default": "#2dd4bf" },
      { "name": "--dur", "description": "Draw duration", "default": "0.25s" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Draw from the center out", "Thicker lines for a bolder frame", "Reverse the draw on mouse-out"],
    "ai_usage": "Minimal and editorial designs. Each pseudo-element covers two sides via border-top/right (and bottom/left) and animates scaleX then scaleY with a transition-delay — the delay is what makes it draw instead of appear."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: 0; }
    button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5cff; outline-offset: 3px; }
    :root { --c: #2dd4bf; --dur: .25s; }
    .bd { position: relative; padding: 1rem 2.4rem; background: transparent; color: #e7ebf3; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .05em; }
    .bd::before, .bd::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
    .bd::before { border-top: 2px solid var(--c); border-right: 2px solid var(--c); transform: scale(0, 1); transform-origin: left; }
    .bd::after { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--c); border-left: 2px solid var(--c); transform: scale(0, 1); transform-origin: right; }
    .bd:hover::before, .bd:hover::after { transform: scale(1, 1); transition: transform var(--dur) ease; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="bd" type="button">Read more</button>
</body>
</html>
